name: bottom-bar
description: A compact rounded bar at the bottom of the terminal and the desktop app (model, effort, context and tokens used, 5-hour and 7-day usage, agents) with a Doole's Tools button that opens a toolbox.

name.title: Pill name
name.description: The name shown on the pill and at the top of the toolbox. Default: Doole's Tools.

colour.title: Colour
colour.description: The accent colour of the bar, the pill and the toolbox: Coral, Amber, Sage, Sky, Lilac or Rose. Default: Coral.
